note: Keeper or Release? (Guide School, John 2026-11-16). The practice rule cards are made up by the page, at random, every round, so no number here or on screen is a real regulation and none can be memorised as one. 'min' and 'max' below are only how long each fish may be drawn on the measuring board (ordinary lengths for the species), never a rule. 'slot' says whether the game may deal this fish a two-ended practice slot or only a smallest-size practice rule.

levels.name: Deckhand
levels.intro: One rule on the card: a smallest size. Read the board, read the card, make the call.

levels.name: Mate
levels.intro: Now some cards have a slot: a smallest size and a biggest size. Too short goes back. So does too long.

levels.name: Guide
levels.intro: Close calls, a season line and a limit. A guide reads the whole card and counts the cooler before the fish.

end.again: Read the card twice, measure once. Try again.
